dict.Marfa primită de la furnizor, produs cu: Goods received from a supplier, item by item: the invoiced quantity versus the quantity counted on arrival; you get the differences in quantity and in lei, shortages (in red), surpluses (in yellow), the total received incl. VAT and the difference from the invoice.
dict.Pentru diferențe faci proces-verbal cu f: For differences, draw up a report with the supplier (Docs → Goods receipt report) and ask for a corrective invoice.
dict.Scrie cantitatea din factură și pe cea n: Enter the invoiced quantity and the quantity counted on arrival: shortages show in red, surpluses in yellow.
